caption: The drawing depicts a single, folded garment laid flat, centered on a plain, light background. The garment appears to be a short-sleeved blouse or chemise, predominantly off-white or cream in color, with subtle shading in light gray and faint brown lines used to create depth and folds. The sleeves are short, wide, and feature a scalloped lace trim along their edges, decorated with small circular motifs. The neckline and the front yoke are similarly bordered by scalloped lace. The front center of the blouse has a rectangular bib-like panel, also edged with lace, and within this panel, there is delicate embroidery of intertwined leaves or vines surrounding small cursive initials. Beneath the blouse, there is a suggestion of folded fabric, rendered with simple lines to indicate layering. The drawing uses soft shadows and minimal background detail, and in the lower right corner, there is a small handwritten inscription.
title: Chemise
